annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 1797/2024 - Estabelece normas gerais para o desenvolvimento, implementação e uso responsável de sistemas de Inteligência Artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1797/2024 - General rules for the development, implementation and responsible use of Artificial Intelligence systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Dr. Allan Garcês)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies bill (PL 1797/2024) setting general rules for responsible AI use to protect human rights. It bans discriminatory uses, biometric categorisation and manipulative techniques, imposes strict liability on providers, grants contestation rights, empowers the ANPD to classify risk, and creates a National AI Council.
key_provisions_or_claims: Bans AI uses that discriminate or repress rights, biometric categorisation by race/politics/religion, untargeted facial-image scraping, and subliminal or manipulative techniques
Strict liability for AI providers/operators for property or moral damage regardless of system autonomy
Right to contest and request review of significant AI decisions and to correct data
ANPD empowered via LGPD amendment to regulate, sanction, and classify AI risk levels
Creates the National Council on AI (CNIA) as an interministerial advisory body
